options.name: kill_switch
options.title: Kill switch
options.description:
Drop forwarded traffic to overseas destinations while the sing-box client is not running (crash, restart, reload or failed start), so nothing leaks out directly. Mainland China and private addresses stay reachable.
Stopping the service from the init script lifts the block; if the client cannot start, internet access stays blocked until it is fixed or the service is stopped.

options.name: block_https_rr
options.title: Block HTTPS/SVCB DNS records
options.description: Answer HTTPS (type 65) and SVCB (type 64) queries with an empty response. Keeps clients off HTTPS-RR/ECH, which this DNS chain cannot serve through some proxies; disable it if ECH is wanted.

options.name: tun_dns_mode
options.title: TUN DNS mode (1.14)
options.description: Since sing-box 1.14 the default (Unset) behaves as hijack: sing-box sets the platform interface DNS and hijacks port 53. On OpenWrt this overlaps with the own dnsmasq/nftables DNS hijack of this plugin, so keep Disabled on a gateway unless you need sing-box to own TUN DNS.

options.name: mode
options.title: Mode
options.description:
The default rule uses the following matching logic:
(domain || domain_suffix || domain_keyword || domain_regex || ip_cidr || ip_is_private) &&
(port || port_range) &&
(source_ip_cidr || source_ip_is_private) &&
(source_port || source_port_range) &&
other fields.
Additionally, included rule sets can be considered merged rather than as a single rule sub-item.
